newsitem.title: UK: GENERAL ACCIDENT UP, WARBURG REPEATS "ADD".
newsitem.headline: GENERAL ACCIDENT UP, WARBURG REPEATS "ADD".

text.p: Shares in insurer General Accident Plc were benefiting from upbeat press comment following strong first half results and positive broker comment on Wednesday.
The shares climbed 14p to 959-1/2p after finishing flat on Tuesday despite record profits.
SBC Warburg repeated its "add" recommendation on the shares and gave a price target of 10.00 stg for the stock, market sources said.
Upbeat comment in the Times newspaper also helped to lift the shares, dealers said.
"There was a little bit of stock that needed clearing out of the market yesterday before the shares could start to perform," one dealer said.
